description: This file defines data models, a store class, and utility functions related to health monitoring within the OpenClaw application. It includes handling of health snapshots, status states, periodic refresh logic, and error reporting for system health checks.

classes.name: HealthSnapshot
classes.description: A Codable structure representing the health status report, including channel summaries, session info, and other metrics.

classes.name: HealthStore
classes.description: A singleton ObservableObject managing the health state, performing periodic checks, and providing status information for the UI.

methods.name: __setSnapshotForTest
methods.description: Test-only method to manually set the health snapshot and error for testing purposes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an on-demand refresh of the health snapshot by communicating with the control channel.

methods.name: resolveLinkChannel
methods.description: Finds the primary linked channel from the health snapshot.

methods.name: resolveFallbackChannel
methods.description: Finds an alternative healthy channel if the primary is not linked.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the failure based on the snapshot.
